title: Audit: crypto2dev shim 2026-04-21
notes: Confidence: FIPS error propagation coverage: 90% — shim correctly maps EACCES to FIPS_NOT_ALLOWED_E on all ioctl paths; no false CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE promotions for FIPS failures found. Key material leak risk: 10% — ForceZero is used consistently on all heap-allocated key structs and all stack-allocated ioctl structs; only concern is the COPY alias bug (wolfssl-yjw.5) which requires an Aes copy that wolfSSL TLS does not perform. GCM auth correctness: 75% — two concrete gaps found (authTagSz < 12 not rejected, encrypt oversized tag silent skip); P-192 ECC gap found. UAPI integrity: 80% — static_assert size guards in place; field-order divergence not catchable without kernel headers (wolfssl-yjw.6). Would raise confidence: run against kernel uapi header with CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_UAPI_HEADER set; valgrind/ASAN run of crypto2dev_test with SIM enabled; verify wolfSSL never calls wc_AesCopy on devId-bound Aes objects in TLS code.
